indicators.label: CPI inflation

next.what: November 2026 CPI (12 December or the next working day)

indicators.definition: Year-on-year change in the all-India Consumer Price Index (combined, base 2024=100) published by MoSPI's National Statistics Office.
indicators.context: October's rise was again led by food: the Consumer Food Price Index rose 8.94 per cent, up from 7.74 per cent in September, with onion prices up 116 per cent on a year earlier. Rural inflation was 6.63 per cent against 5.41 per cent in cities. The headline rate is now above the top of the RBI's 2–6 per cent tolerance band. September's 5.54 per cent was confirmed unchanged in the final data.

sources.name: MoSPI CPI press release for October 2026 (PIB, 12 Nov 2026), as reproduced by indiangovtscheme.com
Reuters: India’s October retail inflation at 6.09% (government data, 12 Nov 2026)

notes: Jan-May 2026 from MoSPI releases on the 2024 base as reported (Jan first printed 2.75, revised 2.74).

indicators.label: RBI repo rate
indicators.definition: The rate at which the RBI lends to banks overnight under the liquidity adjustment facility. The standing deposit facility rate sits 25 basis points below it and the marginal standing facility rate 25 basis points above.
indicators.context: The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 basis points on 7 October 2026 and changed its stance to calibrated tightening. The SDF rate is now 5.25 per cent and the MSF rate 5.75 per cent.

indicators.label: Rupee per US dollar
indicators.definition: Interbank closing rate, rupees per US dollar. A higher number means a weaker rupee.
indicators.context: The rupee had its strongest week of 2026 in the week to 6 November as foreign portfolio inflows and a fall in crude prices supported it. The 2 November figure is the level near which it opened that week.

sources.name: PTI via HDFC Sky, rupee close 9 November 2026
PTI via HDFC Sky, rupee close 4 November 2026
HDFC Sky weekly rupee review, 7 November 2026

indicators.label: 10-year G-Sec yield

next.what: Next trading session; October CPI is released the same day

indicators.definition: Yield on the benchmark 10-year Government of India bond.
indicators.context: The yield rose to a three-year high near 7.5 per cent in late October after the RBI's October hike to 5.50 per cent and tighter banking liquidity, then fell about 30 basis points in early November as crude eased and US Treasury yields softened. Bank of Baroda Research expected a 7.25–7.35 per cent range for November, with risks tilted up; the market is now trading below that range. Market closed on 10 November for a holiday.

sources.name: Trading Economics, India 10-year yield (11 Nov 2026 close)
Bank of Baroda Research outlook, via ANI

indicators.label: Brent crude
indicators.definition: Front-month Brent crude futures, US dollars per barrel.
indicators.context: Brent fell almost 18 per cent between 30 October and 5 November on hopes of a US–Iran settlement, its steepest weekly fall since 2020, before recovering to around $98.

sources.name: HDFC Sky weekly crude review, 7 November 2026
